answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake behind a single hardware-backed identity key before it can transact. A newcomer starts with a tiny spending cap that rises only as its honest history lengthens, like an ember growing into a steady flame instead of a spiral of fresh throwaway accounts. Forging a thousand identities then means buying a thousand keys and locking a thousand stakes, while one bad act burns the whole deposit, so the tide of cheap Sybils costs more than the fraud it enables.
